title: The Cat in the Hat Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 65
rules: If The Cat in the Hat has a Tomatometer score of above 65 on Nov 9, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: No critic reviews were on Rotten Tomatoes yet. Comparable films (the Seuss adaptations The Lorax at 54% and The Grinch at about 60%, plus big-studio animated films outside Pixar and Disney) land near 65% about half the time or less. Early fan reactions on Letterboxd are mixed, and the film was moved from early 2026 to November, so I lean slightly below even odds despite the directors' good track records and a likable lead.
blind.falsifier: If the embargo lifts with mostly positive reviews (for example, the Tomatometer opens in the 80s with 50+ reviews and holds through Nov 9), this forecast was too low; a score in the 40s-50s would confirm it.

final.reasoning: The market at 70% likely reflects positive post-premiere buzz, which pulls me up from 43%. That buzz is usually unreliable for predicting critics, and base rates for this type of film sit near the 65% threshold, so 70% looks too high.
